name: Is Local AI Optimization expensive?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Local AI Optimization varies widely based on the scope of work, the size of your business, the competitiveness of your industry, and the specific services required. It can range from basic initial setup and content optimization to comprehensive ongoing strategies involving advanced structured data implementation and continuous content refinement. Businesses typically invest in a tailored plan that aligns with their goals and budget. It's an investment aimed at future-proofing your local digital presence and capturing emerging search trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for Local AI Optimization vary by scope, business size, and industry. It's an investment designed to enhance future local digital visibility.
